From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter Slate: orchestration plan and exec clearance (Q3 kickoff)

Team —

Attached is the Q3 slate I promised after the leadership prep call. High level ask: we need executive clearance on the objective set and the proposed owner commitments by end of week so CS and GTM can prepare the QBR packet. Key points in the sheet:
- Three product-facing objectives (Serving runtime, Dedicated throughput, Private pilots) with measurable KR targets.
- Two go-to-market objectives focused on low-friction trials and a partner co-sell pilot.
- Proposed gating: throughput test (perf SLOs) by 7/12, SLA language for Dedicated by 7/20.

My asks:
1) Laura — can you validate the customer-impact priorities and call out any ask that needs exec negotiation with Acme?
2) Lauren — we need sales acceptance criteria and a go/no-go recommendation for the pilot KPIs (attached tab).
3) Marissa — please confirm QBR slide owners and whether the readout packet needs a separate security appendix for Acme.

I've attached Q3_OKR_Draft_v5.xlsx and a starter QBR_readout_packet_v2.pdf. If anyone expects major changes, flag them now so we can run a quick revision and not delay exec clearance.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sr. GTM Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_OKR_Draft_v5.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR_readout_packet_v2.pdf (pptx stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quarter Slate: orchestration plan and exec clearance (Q3 kickoff)

Sergio — thanks for driving this. Quick read: the objectives map to the exec narrative, but I have two requests before I can clear it upward:

- Customer prioritization: the Acme ask (page 2 / tab 'Acme asks') should surface as a time-boxed commitment (they asked for a private deployment pilot + SOC2 evidence). We should add a bullet for 'security appendix required for pilot' with owner and ETA.
- Revenue recognition: for Dedicated commitments, the way the units are framed in the spreadsheet looks like a binding quota — can we add language that these are target commitments pending procurement? That avoids an accidental SLA promise.

If we can get a revision by EOD Wednesday with those two clarifications, I can present to execs on Thursday morning.

Also tagging Todd Lin (copied below) from the Acme deal — Todd, FYI on timing.

— Laura
VP, Customer Success

Adding sales perspective — I pulled the pilot criteria into the sheet and added a scoring row for 'trial health' (usage, latency, retention signal). My recommendations:

- Pilot go/no-go: require 3 paid trials reaching baseline latency < 120ms and > 20% week-2 retention before scaling the co-sell pilot.
- For Dedicated commitments, change wording to 'reserved capacity proposal' and include procurement contingency.

Also small ask: can we trim the readout packet to one page per objective for the exec slide deck? Marissa, if you can own the condensed slides I will feed the metrics.

Lauren
Head of Sales Ops
